paused_battery_phone: Paused: this phone is on battery.
paused_battery_pc: Paused: this PC is on battery.
paused_charge_unknown: Paused: can't tell whether this phone is charging (Termux:API missing? See docs/android.md).
ready: Ready to compute for your other machines.
paused_in_use: Paused: this PC is in use (resumes after {minutes} min without activity).
paused_in_use_battery: Paused: this PC is in use and on battery.
ready_low_priority: Ready to compute for your other machines, at low priority while you use this PC.
ready_low_priority_unmeasured: Ready to compute for your other machines, at low priority (this PC's activity can't be measured).
result_too_big: result too large to send back ({size}, at most {limit}): to be computed on its owner's machine
failed_io: read or write error on the computing machine
failed_compute: computation failed on the computing machine ({kind})
size_unreadable: unreadable file size in the order received
file_too_big: announced file too large ({size} MB, at most {limit} MB)
file_altered: file received incomplete or changed during the transfer
